items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Louis Armstrong was there. [INTERVIEWEE] He was, he was there.

ctx.x: Well, he was licking sick, you know, walking around sick, yeah. He'd be standing up talking to you sometime. He'd tell you got to go home and lay down. He'd suffer with that sick, sickness a lot. Well, I played.
That was one of the big funerals, I guess. I think Louis Armstrong was there.
He was, he was there. Because me and Howard and George Louis and them, we had the band, we played at the funeral. We made up a band and played at the funeral.
